mechanism_narrative: A historically low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below the 20-year historical median.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI inflation rate exceeding 4.0% year-over-year (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 4.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market tightness that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above the 20-year historical median.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate output and profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline from prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), rising CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation requiring further tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% in 1 month.
